biggest_catch: Superprof's $20-$80/hr range and 0% commission are official - but Superprof never touches your money: students pay you directly, so there is no platform payout schedule to verify.
catches: No platform payout schedule: official help says students pay via secure messaging or directly with the tutor; timing is per tutor-student agreement.
Official $20-$80/hr range exists and commission is 0%, but every payment must be chased individually.
Students must buy a Student Pass to contact tutors, which throttles inbound leads.
Your rate is self-set, so market competition sets your real pay, not the platform.

c1.evidence: superprof.com: 'Pay Range: Earn between $20-$80/hr'; 'The rate that is shown in your ad is the rate that you have chosen, and what you will receive. We don't take any commission!'

c2.evidence: superprof.com help: 'Payment for lessons - It's up to you! You can pay for your lessons via our secure messaging system or directly with your tutor.' No platform payout schedule exists.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee documented in official terms.

c4.evidence: Official $20-$80/hr range exists, but payout timing is not a platform mechanism - it is negotiated directly with each student.

eligibility: Open to all; free tutor ad; no certification required; students buy a Student Pass to contact tutors.
maximize: Superprof is rejected here because payment timing is negotiated with each student, not paid on a platform schedule. If you use it anyway: your listed rate is take-home (0% commission), so price a few dollars under local rivals to fill your calendar, publish free ads in multiple subjects, and always confirm payment terms with each student before the first lesson.
notes: Official: superprof.com/tutor ('$20-$80/hr', zero commission) and superprof.com help article ('Payment for lessons': via secure messaging or directly with tutor, commission free). Rejected because payment timing is a direct student-tutor agreement, not a platform payout schedule.

steps: Create a free tutor ad on Superprof and set your own rate within the $20-$80/hr range.
Wait for students with a Student Pass to contact you through secure messaging.
Agree payment terms directly with each student before teaching.
Deliver lessons; students pay you directly, not via a platform payout schedule.
